stem:
The table shows the relationship between y, the cost to rent a boat, and x, the amount of time the boat is rented.

Boat Rental Costs

| Time, x (hours) | Cost, y (dollars) |
|-----------------|-------------------|
| 1               | 32                |
| 3               | 56                |
| 5               | 80                |
| 7               | 104               |

Which graph best represents the relationship between x and y shown in the table?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with x-axis 0 to 80, y-axis 0 to 5, line from origin ascending

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with x-axis 0 to 5, y-axis 32 to 152, line ascending through points

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with x-axis 32 to 152, y-axis 0 to 5, line ascending

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with x-axis 0 to 5, y-axis 0 to 80, line ascending
